adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `#update` does not persist any changes and simply re-renders the current `@embedding` via `EmbeddingSerializer`. This is consistent with `fetch_embedding` building an `OpenStruct` (not an AR model) that only exposes `embeddable_hosts`, which are modified through the separate `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`create/update/destroy`). However, the route includes `put "customize/embedding"` and the Ember controller has a `saveChanges()` action calling `this.get('embedding').update({});`, suggesting an intended but currently no-op update endpoint (likely dead/incomplete functionality), not a directly verifiable runtime defect from the diff alone.
